202.description: the account is locked and its deletion is queued

job_id.description: The ID of the account.delete.v1 job that deletes the account's data.

400.description: invalid request; an email that does not match the account returns confirmation_mismatch, and other invalid input, such as a missing email or reason, has an empty body

404.description: user not found or already deleted

409.description: the target is an administrator (admin_account) or its deletion is already filed (account_deletion_in_progress)
